description: This file provides utilities for handling HTTP request bodies, including reading with size and timeout limits, error handling, and request body validation in a Node.js environment.

classes.name: RequestBodyLimitError
classes.description: Custom error class for request body size and timeout violations.

methods.name: isRequestBodyLimitError
methods.description: Type guard to check if an error is a RequestBodyLimitError, optionally matching a specific error code.

methods.name: requestBodyErrorToText
methods.description: Converts a RequestBodyLimitErrorCode to a human-readable string message.

methods.name: readRequestBodyWithLimit
methods.description: Reads the request body as a string with size and timeout limits, throwing or returning errors accordingly.

methods.name: readJsonBodyWithLimit
methods.description: Reads and parses JSON from the request body with size and timeout limits, handling errors gracefully.

methods.name: installRequestBodyLimitGuard
methods.description: Sets up a guard on the request to enforce size limits and respond with errors if limits are exceeded.
